snippet.title: Psycho Dead - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Steam :  https://steam.pm/app/3018390
GOG :  https://www.gog.com/en/game/psycho_dead
PlayStation : https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015857
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
""PSYCHO DEAD"" is a third-person survival horror game centered on Elixia, a mysterious girl with psychic powers, who must escape a secret laboratory infested with grotesque and monstrous creatures. Explore a sci-fi setting filled with mystery and danger, where terror awaits at every corner, and discover the truth behind the horrific incident. 

PSYCHO DEAD launches on Q1 2027.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
